code='''def transform(grid):
    # Read the colored marks at intersections of the periodic separator lines.
    # Interior separator rows/columns form the compact pattern; replace the
    # separator/background color with the tile color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # the separators are at regular intervals; retain those strictly inside
    # the outer border.
    rows = rows[1:-1]
    cols = cols[1:-1]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    tile = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (bg, grid[1][1])), grid[1][1])
    return [[tile if grid[r][c] == bg else grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
# compute intended via row/col separators manually

code='''def transform(grid):
    # Read the repeated separator intersections, excluding the final boundary.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # infer periods from the regular grid spacing
    dr, dc = (9, 4) if h > 25 else (3, 4)
    rs = list(range(0, h, dr))
    cs = list(range(0, w, dc))
    # Drop the last edge line; separator color becomes the interior tile color.
    rs, cs = rs[:-1], cs[:-1]
    background = grid[0][0] if grid[0][0] != 6 else 6
    tile = next((x for row in grid for x in row if x not in (6, background)), 3)
    return [[tile if grid[r][c] == 6 else grid[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]
'''
